_about: Public-domain Henry Scudder, Puritan minister and member of the Westminster Assembly, for the Word Hoard: A Key of Heaven (the Lord's Prayer opened), The Christian's Daily Walk in Holy Security and Peace, and The Godly Man's Choice. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 133 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
